rows: Issued to: Damietta Combined Cycle Power Station

This document sets out the steps for the weekly inspection of the fire-water pumps. The fire-water network is fed by three pumps: the first is the jockey pump, which makes up for leakages in the fire line and maintains the fire network pressure within normal limits. The second is the electric fire pump, the main fire pump, which operates when the fire systems operate or when the fire hydrants are opened. The third is the diesel pump, which operates if the main pump fails. This document was prepared by Eng. Yousry Abdel Halim Abdel Latif, tested by Eng. Wasfy William Nashed – Senior Engineer, Occupational Safety and Health Department – and approved by Eng. Ahmed El-Husseiny Abdullah, General Manager. It was reviewed by Chemist Ahmed El-Sayed Ibrahim and Eng. Soliman Zaki Soliman, General Manager of Quality Assurance and Quality Control, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Mohamed Farag Anan – Head of Damietta Power Station Sector – and Eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa, Head of Quality Assurance and Quality Control Sector, East Delta Electricity Production Company.
Issue a work order by the Occupational Safety and Health Department
No special tools are needed during inspection work
Make sure there are no oil, fuel or water leaks
Make sure the pump is clean and there is no waste around it
Make sure there is no corrosion on any parts of the pumps
Make sure there are no loud or abnormal sounds while the pumps are running
Make sure there is no vibration on the pumps
Check the diesel lubricating oil level
Make sure the fire diesel batteries are clean and the electrical connections are tightly fastened
Make sure the ventilation fans of the diesel enclosure and the diesel room are operating
Make sure the pump start switch is on automatic
Make sure all parts of the pump are tightly fastened
Make sure the gland cooling water pressure is at a suitable quantity
Make sure the diesel pump belts are correctly tensioned and undamaged
Make sure the ball bearing temperature is within normal limits
Make sure the diesel engine cooling water heater is operating
Make sure the air filter and the diesel fuel filter are clean
Make sure the diesel fuel tank is full and drain any water found in the tank
Check the acid solution level in the batteries
During the weekly run, check the soundness of the diesel lubricating oil pressure and the fuel pressure and the soundness of all gauges and operating indicators
